stem:
Sagar models integers with tokens. He has $5$ positive tokens and must subtract $8$ positive tokens.

Which move lets him complete the subtraction?

options.text: The finished difference is the label negative tokens.
Remove $8$ positive tokens from the $5$ he has.
Add $3$ zero pairs, then remove $8$ positive tokens; $3$ negative tokens remain.
He removes $8$ positives first and only afterwards adds zero pairs to repair the model.

teacher.key_rationale: He needs 8 positives to remove but has only 5, so he adds 3 zero pairs first. After removing 8 positives, 3 negatives remain (−3). Naming the label, removing without zero pairs, or reversing the order of the move all miss that sequence.
